messages:
jules: Heads-up - I hit a neat little SSE "byte-stitch" when doing very fast reconnects in the new sampleapp. node-sdk v1.4.4.

jules: Repro: start stream -> send one event but do NOT send the final blank-line -> kill client (SIGINT) -> restart <150ms -> send next event. Sometimes parser emits a single data event that contains both JSON blobs concatenated.

jules: Raw capture (trimmed):
```
# conn A tail
data: {\"part\":\"first\"}
# no trailing blank line, process exits
# conn B head
data: {\"part\":\"second\"}
# server-side view sometimes: 
data: {\"part\":\"first\"}
data: {\"part\":\"second\"}
# node parser produced a single `data` value: "{...}{...}" -> JSON parse fail
```

mike: I think this is the buffer-not-cleared-on-close issue we've seen. Does parser flush on `end` or `close`?

jules: current behavior: parser waits for 

 delimiter to emit assembled event. If socket closes with partial buffer it currently keeps buffer until next delimiter. That allows next connection bytes to be appended.

anya: two easy fixes: (A) on socket `close`/`end` force-drop partial buffer; (B) on socket `close` emit a comment `:partial` followed by the partial payload so downstream JSON parsers ignore it. I'd prefer (B) for demos.

mike: agree. Also treat a leading `id:` or `event:` line on new connection as an implicit delimiter. That catches a lot of reconnect cases.

jules: patched local branch to emit `:partial-truncated` comment on close and reset buffer; added opt-in flag `sseHandlePartial=\"comment\"|\"drop\"|\"legacy\"` defaulting to `legacy`. With `comment` the merged-JSON repro disappeared in ~200 runs.

anya: please add a tiny integration test that simulates quick kill+reconnect (use child_process to SIGINT then respawn). CI should run this on loopback.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-2410: "SSE: byte-stitch on fast reconnects -> parser buffer not cleared" (https://tracker.internal/DEVEX-2410)

mike: also document in docs/streaming.md recommending server-side double-newline flush after events and how to enable the opt-in flag for demos. We'll backport to 1.3.x since sampleapp pinned there for some partners.

jules: PR ready at https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/923 - includes unit test and integration harness. Requesting review from @mike @anya.

anya: LGTM, one nit about test timeouts. Once green we can merge and cut patch release. Good catch before partner demo.
